reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that provides selectable chat content width tiers, persists the choice locally, and adjusts related panels through the application layout service.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供标准、中等、宽、超宽和全宽五档聊天内容宽度选择，并保存用户的选择。
summaries.en: Adds five selectable chat content width tiers to the DeepSeek Harness Web client and remembers the user’s choice.

capabilities: Modifies chat content width through an inline CSS variable override
Provides a floating picker for five width tiers
Persists the selected tier in localStorage
Uses the application layout and locale services to adjust panels and labels
